:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.3, Chap 3.9.6.1 (Table 38) of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/listItemPrefix.xml).
:::

`listItemPrefix` is the attribute that gives the symbol placed before the items of an unordered list (such as `randomList`). It is optional.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 3 elements carry this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attentionRandomList` | 28 | Optional |
| `randomList` | 28 | Optional |
| `reducedRandomList` | 1 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided in two steps: by the XML schema and by BREX (Business Rules Exchange).

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `listItemPrefixAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The values are an enumeration of 99 values, from `pf01` to `pf99` |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00208) | Allows 8 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//@listItemPrefix`. The rule applies to all schemas |

Of the values in the XML schema enumeration, the 43 values `pf08` to `pf50` are not allowed by BREX-S1-00208. They pass XML schema validation, but they are violations in a check against the default BREX.

BREX-S1-00208 allows the following values and defines how a lower-level BREX can tailor each of them.

| Value | `valueForm` | `valueTailoring` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pf01` to `pf07` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `pf51~pf99` | `range` | `restrictable` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `pf01` | No symbol; only an indent |
| `pf02` | A symbol that depends on the level of the list |
| `pf03` | A short dash |
| `pf04` | A dot inside a circle |
| `pf05` | An outline circle |
| `pf06` | An outline square |
| `pf07` | A bullet |
| `pf51` to `pf99` | Values whose meaning the project defines |

## Related rules

- A `reducedRandomList` in a front matter title page has `listItemPrefix` set to `pf03` and uses no other attribute (BREX-S1-00117 of the default BREX).

| Operation | Tool |
